title: Get Custom Conversions associated with an event source
content_data:
Use this endpoint to retrieve the Custom Conversions associated with a Pixel or an App. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/custom_conversion/list/ **Method** GET **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|Authorized access token. For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1738373164380162).| ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | |advertiser_id {Required}|string|Advertiser ID.| |event_source_type {Required}|string|Event source type.

Enum values:
  • `PIXEL`: Pixel.
  • `APP`: App.
| |event_source_id {Required}|string|Event source ID.

  • When `event_source_type` is `PIXEL`, specify a Pixel ID.
    • To obtain IDs of Pixels within your ad account, use [/pixel/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740858697598978) and check the returned `pixel_id`.
  • When `event_source_type` is `APP`, specify the app platform ID of a Self Attribution Network (SAN) App.
    • To obtain app platform IDs of SAN Apps within your ad account, use [/app/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740859313270786). Confirm that the returned `self_attribution_enabled` for the App is `true` and check the returned `app_platform_id`.
| |search_keyword|string|The keyword to search for Custom Conversions by.
You can search by Custom Conversion name or Custom Conversion ID.

  • When you search by Custom Conversion name, fuzzy matches are supported.
  • When you search by Custom Conversion ID, exact matches are supported.
| |sort_field|string|Sorting field.

Enum values:
  • `CREATE_TIME`: The time when the Custom Conversion was created.
  • `TOTAL_COUNT`: The total conversion count for the Custom Conversion.
Default value: `CREATE_TIME`.| |sort_type|string|Sorting type.

Enum values:
  • `DESC`: descending.
  • `ASC`: ascending.
Default value: `DESC`.| |page|number|Current page number.

Value range: ≥ 1.
Default value: 1.| |page_size|number|Page size.

Value range: 1-1,000.
Default value: 10.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request GET 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/custom_conversion/list/?advertiser_id={{advertiser_id}}&event_source_type=PIXEL&event_source_id={{event_source_id}}&page=1&page_size=1000' \ --header 'Access-token: {{Access-token}}' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data|object|Returned data.| #|list|object[]|The list of Custom Conversions associated with the event source.| ##|custom_conversion_id|string|The ID of the Custom Conversion.| ##|name|string|The name of the Custom Conversion.| ##|description|string|The description of the Custom Conversion.| ##|event_source_type|string|Event source type.

Enum values:
  • `PIXEL`: Pixel.
  • `APP`: App.
| ##|event_source_id|string|Event source ID.

  • When `event_source_type` is `PIXEL`, this field represents a Pixel ID.
    • To obtain IDs of Pixels within your ad account, use [/pixel/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740858697598978) and check the returned `pixel_id`.
  • When `event_source_type` is `APP`, this field represents the app platform ID of a Self Attribution Network (SAN) App.
    • To obtain app platform IDs of SAN Apps within your ad account, use [/app/list/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1740859313270786). Confirm that the returned `self_attribution_enabled` for the App is `true` and check the returned `app_platform_id`.
| ##|activity_info|object|Details of the activity for the Custom Conversion.| ###|activity_status|string|The activity status of the Custom Conversion.

Enum values:
  • `NO_RECENT_ACTIVITY`: No recent activity. Activity received, but not in the past 7 days.
  • `ACTIVE`: Active. Activity received in the past 7 days.
  • `WAITING_FOR_ACTIVITY`: Inactive. No activity received in the past 90 days.
| ###|total_count|number|The total conversion count for the Custom Conversion.| ###|last_record_time|string|The time when activity for the Custom Conversion was last received, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS` (UTC+0).

Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`.| ##|optimization_event|string|The conversion event (standard event) associated with the Custom Conversion.

For enum values, see [List of values for `optimization_event`](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1842225226006530#item-link-List%20of%20values%20for%20optimization_event).| ##|rules|object[]|Details of the conversion rules for the Custom Conversion.

Only actions that meet these conditions will count as Custom Conversions.| ###|parameter|string|Parameter.

Enum values:
  • `BRAND`: `brand`.
  • `CONTENT_CATEGORY`: `content_category`.
  • `CONTENT_ID`: `content_id`.
  • `CONTENT_NAME`: `content_name`.
  • `CONTENT_TYPE`: `content_type`.
  • `CURRENCY`: `currency`.
  • `DESCRIPTION`: `description`.
  • `EVENT_ID`: `event_id`.
  • `NUM_ITEMS`: `num_items`.
  • `PRICE`: `price`.
  • `SEARCH_STRING`: `search_string`.
  • `STATUS`: `status`.
  • `URL`: `url`.
  • `VALUE`: `value`.
| ###|operator|string|Operator.

  • When `parameter` is `BRAND`, `CONTENT_CATEGORY`, `CONTENT_ID`, `CONTENT_NAME`, `CONTENT_TYPE`, `DESCRIPTION`, `EVENT_ID`, `SEARCH_STRING`, `STATUS`, or `URL`, the enum values are:
    • `CONTAIN`: Contains.
    • `NOT_CONTAIN`: Does not contain.
    • `START_WITH`: Starts with.
    • `EQUAL`: Is equal to.
    • `NOT_EQUAL`: Is not equal to.
  • When `parameter` is `NUM_ITEMS`, `PRICE`, or `VALUE`, the enum values are:
    • `EQUAL`: Is equal to.
    • `NOT_EQUAL`: Is not equal to.
    • `LT`: Is less than.
    • `GT`: Is greater than.
    • `LTE`: Is less than or equal to.
    • `GTE`: Is greater than or equal to.
  • When `parameter` is `CURRENCY`, the enum values are:
    • `EQUAL`: Is equal to.
    • `NOT_EQUAL`: Is not equal to.
| ###|values|string[]|Values for the parameter.

  • When `parameter` is `BRAND`, `CONTENT_CATEGORY`, `CONTENT_ID`, `CONTENT_NAME`, `CONTENT_TYPE`, `DESCRIPTION`, `EVENT_ID`, `SEARCH_STRING`, `STATUS`, `URL`, the field will be an array of strings, each with a maximum length of 100 characters and up to 100 entries.
  • When `parameter` is `NUM_ITEMS`, the field will be an integer between 0 and 1,000,000,000.
  • When `parameter` is `PRICE`, `VALUE`, the field will be a float kept to two decimal places, within the range from 0.00 to 1,000,000,000.00.
  • When `parameter` is `CURRENCY`, the field will be an array of strings. To learn about the enum values, see [List of currency values](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1842225226006530#item-link-List%20of%20currency%20values).| ###|create_time|string|The time when the Custom Conversion was created, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`(UTC+0).

    Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`.| ###|update_time|string|The time when the Custom Conversion was last updated, in the format of `YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS`(UTC+0).

    Example: `2025-01-01 00:00:01`.| #|page_info|object|Pagination information.| ##|page|number|Current page number.| ##|page_size|number|Page size.| ##|total_number|number|Total number of results.| ##|total_page|number|Total pages of results.| ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "list": [ { "activity_info": { "activity_status": "WAITING_FOR_ACTIVITY", "total_count": 0 }, "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "custom_conversion_id": "{{custom_conversion_id}}", "description": "{{description}}", "event_source_id": "{{event_source_id}}", "event_source_type": "PIXEL", "name": "{{name}}", "optimization_event": "SHOPPING", "rules": [ { "operator": "NOT_CONTAIN", "parameter": "EVENT_ID", "values": [ "{{event_id}}", "{{event_id}}" ] }, { "operator": "START_WITH", "parameter": "DESCRIPTION", "values": [ "{{description_value}}" ] } ], "update_time": "{{update_time}}" }, { "activity_info": { "activity_status": "NO_RECENT_ACTIVITY", "last_record_time": "{{last_record_time}}", "total_count": 1 }, "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "custom_conversion_id": "{{custom_conversion_id}}", "description": "", "event_source_id": "{{event_source_id}}", "event_source_type": "PIXEL", "name": "{{name}}", "optimization_event": "ON_WEB_CART", "rules": [ { "operator": "CONTAIN", "parameter": "CONTENT_ID", "values": [ "{{content_id}}" ] } ], "update_time": "{{update_time}}" }, ... { "activity_info": { "activity_status": "ACTIVE", "last_record_time": "{{last_record_time}}", "total_count": 20 }, "create_time": "{{create_time}}", "custom_conversion_id": "{{custom_conversion_id}}", "description": "", "event_source_id": "{{event_source_id}}", "event_source_type": "PIXEL", "name": "{{name}}", "optimization_event": "SHOPPING", "rules": [ { "operator": "CONTAIN", "parameter": "STATUS", "values": [ "{{status_value}}" ] } ], "update_time": "{{update_time}}" } ], "page_info": { "page": 1, "page_size": 1000, "total_number": 98, "total_page": 1 } } } (/code) ```
seo_title: Get TikTok Custom Conversions associated with event sources
seo_description: Use this endpoint to retrieve the Custom Conversions associated with a Pixel or an App. Find the detailed parameters and accepted values.
